tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Metrics on inner product spaces]

Source: petersen:page-0022 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-manifold ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-isometry ↗ ex:pet-ch1-euclidean-space

1. ch1:1.1.2An inner product on a finite-dimensional real vector space $V$ defines the constant metric $g((p,v),(p,w))=v\cdot w$. A linear isometry between two such spaces of equal dimension is a Riemannian isometry. Consequently every $n$-dimensional model of this form is isometric to $(\mathbb {R}^n,g_{\mathbb {R}^n})$. \end{example}
